# prime-listbox

prime-rs: Listbox component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/listbox) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-listbox) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/listbox.md)

Listbox — port of `p-listbox` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Markup and classes as in PrimeNG: root `div.p-listbox`, header `p-listbox-header` ("select all" checkbox and search field in
`p-iconfield`), container `p-listbox-list-container` and list `ul.p-listbox-list[role=listbox]` with options
`li.p-listbox-option`, group headers `li.p-listbox-option-group` and the empty list message.

The value is a two-way signal: `value: RwSignal<Option<String>>` in single mode and
`values: RwSignal<Vec<String>>` with `multiple`; without them the component keeps internal state.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_listbox::{Listbox, ListboxOption};

let value = RwSignal::new(Some("LDN".to_owned()));
let options = vec![ListboxOption::new("New York", "NY"), ListboxOption::new("London", "LDN")];
let html = view! { <Listbox options=options value=value /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-listbox-list") && html.contains("p-listbox-option-selected"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-listbox = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["listbox"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
